blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Head-pose variation introduces substantial appearance transformations in visual speech recognition (VSR), making pose-aware feature modulation desirable. However, performance degradation and unwanted feature interactions may result from using numerous Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) circuits with fixed modulation intensity. We propose a Pose Adaptive Dynamic FiLM framework with a Dynamic Residual FiLM (DR-FiLM) modulator that predicts input-dependent weights to adaptively control the strength of pose-conditioned modulation. Experiments on LRS2 and LRS3 demonstrate that unweighted multi-pathway modulation substantially degrades phoneme recognition, increasing PER to 20.33% and 29.42%, respectively, compared with 16.20% and 20.96% for the single ResFiLM configuration. In contrast, the proposed DR-FiLM with dynamic Deep–Res weighting reduces PER to 15.74% on LRS2 and 23.91% on LRS3, substantially mitigating the adverse effects of unweighted modulation. The analysis of the learned weights further reveals a consistent tendency to assign greater weight to the deeper FiLM pathway as head-pose variation increases. These results show that merging pose-conditioned FiLM circuits is more efficient when the modulation strength is dynamically controlled.
blocks.zh: 头-头变异在视觉语音识别(VSR)中引入了实质性的外观转变,使得姿势感知特征的调制是可取的. 然而,性能退化和不想要的特征相互作用可能是由于使用许多具有固定调制强度的地貌-智能线性调制(FiLM)电路。 我们提出一个Pose适应性动态FiLM框架,配有动态残余FiLM(DR-FiLM)调制器,预测依赖输入的权重,以适应性地控制姿势条件调制的强度. LRS2和LRS3的实验表明,未加权的多路径调制会大幅降低电话识别,PER分别提高到20.33%和29.42%,而单张ResFiLM配置的PER则分别上升到16.20%和20.96%. 相比之下,拟议的DR-FiLM具有动态的Deep–Res权重使得PER在LRS2上降低到15.74%,在LRS3上降低到23.91%,大大减轻了未加权调制的不利影响. 对所学到的权重的分析进一步揭示出一种一贯的趋势,即随着头-头变异的增加,对更深的FiLM路径给予更大的权重。 这些结果表明,当调制强度被动态控制时,合并装配条件的FiLM电路的效率更高.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Lip-reading is a form of V-ASR that derives spoken words from visual cues of facial articulatory features, particularly lip movements. Many existing VSR approaches directly predict words or entire sentences from visual speech [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . However, direct word-level prediction can be challenged by speaker-dependent variations, large vocabularies, and subtle visual differences between words. This has motivated phonetic representations, in which phoneme-level prediction provides a more fine-grained representation of visual speech and reduces word-level ambiguity. Despite this advantage, phoneme-level VSR remains sensitive to appearance variations caused by head-pose changes. Such variations alter the spatial configuration and appearance of the lip region, making recognition more challenging under large or unconstrained viewing angles. Prior studies have addressed this difficulty through multi-view representation learning [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] and pose-oriented data augmentation or synthetic view generation [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] ; however, these approaches either rely on predefined viewpoints or synthetic transformations, rather than explicitly modeling pose-induced representation changes within the VSR network.
blocks.zh: 唇读(Lip-reading)是V-ASR的一种形式,它来源于面部动脉特征的视觉提示,尤其是唇动. 许多现有的VSR方法直接预测视觉语音的词或整个句子[1,2,3,4,5]. 然而,直接的词层预测可以被依赖扬声器的变体,大词汇,以及词之间的细微的视觉差异所挑战. 这激发了语音表达,其中电话me级的预测为视觉语音提供了更精细的表述,并减少了词级的模糊性. 尽管有这一优势,电话me级的VSR仍然对头-pose变化造成的外观变化很敏感. 这种变化改变了唇区域的空间布局和外观,使得在大或不受限制的取景角度下识别更具挑战性. 先前的研究通过多视图表达式学习[6,7,8,9]和面向姿势的数据增强或合成视图生成[10,11,12,13]解决了这一困难;然而,这些方法要么依赖于预先确定的观点,要么依赖于合成转化,而不是在VSR网络中明确模拟姿势引起的表达式变化.

blocks.en: To solve this limitation, our prior research presented HP-VSR-ResFiLM [ 14 ] , which conditions visual feature modulation on estimated head posture. While it generates sample-adaptive modulation parameters ( α \alpha and γ \gamma ) based on head pose, it applies these modulations through a rigid, unweighted structure where all FiLM pathways contribute uniformly regardless of posture variation. This fixed weighting setup may not be optimal for all utterances, as varied head-pose conditions may necessitate different levels of feature modification across layers.This raises a crucial question: can the model dynamically select or weight which pose-conditioned feature pathways are best suited to each input?
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一限制,我们先前的研究提出了HP-VSR-ResFiLM[14],它以视觉特征在估计头部姿态上的调制为条件. 虽然它根据头部姿势产生采样适应性调制参数(α\α和γ\γ),但是它通过一个刚性,不加权的结构来应用这些调制,所有FiLM路径无论姿势变化都统一贡献. 这种固定的权重设置可能不是所有言论的最好设置,因为不同的头像条件可能要求各层进行不同程度的特征修改。 这提出了一个重要的问题:模型能否动态地选择或加权,摆设条件化的特征路径最适合每一种输入?

blocks.en: Motivated by this observation, our proposed framework extends HP-VSR-ResFiLM [ 14 ] by adaptively weighting multiple pose-conditioned FiLM pathways according to the input. The main contributions of this study are: 1) We introduce a Dynamic Residual FiLM (DR-FiLM) Modulator with a dynamic weighting mechanism that adaptively controls the modulation strength of multiple pose-conditioned FiLM pathways. 2) We study several configurations of Deep FiLM and ResFiLM pathways and show that adaptive weighting can reduce performance loss caused by unweighted multi-pathway modulation. 3) We examine the acquired dynamic weights over several yaw ranges, gaining insight into how the model adjusts its dependence on distinct FiLM routes under varied head-position situations.
blocks.zh: 基于这一观察,我们拟议的框架扩展了HP-VSR-ResFiLM[14],根据投入对多个姿势条件的FiLM路径进行适应性加权。 这项研究的主要贡献是: 1)我们引入了动态残余FiLM(DR-FiLM)模块,具有动态加权机制,可适应性地控制多个姿势条件的FiLM路径的调节强度. 2)我们研究了Deep FiLM和ResFiLM路径的几种配置,并表明适应性加权可以减少未加权的多路径调制导致的性能损失. 3)我们研究了在几个亚乌范围内获得的动态权重,了解该模型如何在不同的头部位置情况下调整其对不同的FiLM路线的依赖。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed architecture. Head-pose features dynamically determine the contribution of the Deep FiLM pathways at ResNet 18 Layers 3–4 and the ResFiLM pathway for pose-adaptive feature modulation.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议架构概览。 Head-pose 特性能动态地确定ResNet 18 Layes 3–4的深FiLM路径和ResFiLM路径对姿势适应特性调制的贡献。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: Framework Overview. The proposed framework is shown in Figure 1 . The visual and head-pose encoders retain the same architecture as in [ 14 ] . In the visual pathway, the existing FiLM modules at 2D ResNet 18 frontend Layers 3 and 4 (Deep FiLM) are retained, and an additional ResBlock-FiLM (ResFiLM) module is added after the 2D ResNet 18. Moreover, the encoded head-pose features are used by two components: a FiLM generator that produces the modulation parameters γ \gamma and β \beta , and a residual weight generator that predicts input-dependent weights w deep w_{\mathrm{deep}} and w res w_{\mathrm{res}} for the Deep FiLM and ResFiLM pathways, respectively. These parameters and weights are used by the proposed DR-FiLM modulator to adaptively control the strength of pose-conditioned modulation. The resulting visual features are subsequently combined with the head-pose features through an MLP, while the remaining phoneme prediction architecture follows the previous framework.

blocks.en: Unlike conventional FiLM [ 15 ] and directly gated FiLM formulations [ 16 ] , which were originally developed for different applications, the proposed DR-FiLM adopts their feature modulation formulation while introducing a dynamically weighted pose-conditioned modulation term for VSR. Specifically, DR-FiLM retains the original feature representation as a base term and introduces dynamically weighted modulation through the Deep FiLM and ResFiLM pathways. The dynamic weights w deep w_{\mathrm{deep}} and w res w_{\mathrm{res}} therefore control the strength of pose-conditioned modulation in the respective pathways.
blocks.zh: 与传统的FiLM[15]和直接加门的FiLM配体[16]不同,拟议的DR-FiLM采用了它们的特征调制配体,同时为VSR引入了动态加权的姿势条件调制术语. 具体来说,DR-FiLM保留了原始的特征代表作为基词,并通过Deep FiLM和ResFiLM路径引入动态加权调制. 动态权重 w 深 w_{\ mathrm{ deep}} 和 w res w_{\ mathrm{res}}] 因此控制了各自路径中姿势条件调制的强度.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. Experiments are conducted on the publicly available English visual speech datasets LRS2 [ 20 ] , LRS3 [ 21 ] . LRS2 contains approximately 144k utterances (224.5 h), while LRS3 comprises approximately 152k utterances (438.9 h), with both datasets providing separate pretraining, training/validation, and test partitions.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 在公开的英语视觉语音数据集LRS2[20],LRS3[21]上进行实验. LRS2包含约144k的语音(224.5 h),而LRS3包含约152k的语音(438.9 h),两个数据集分别提供预训,培训/验证和测试分区.

blocks.en: Experimental Configuration. The training and evaluation protocols follow our previous HP-VSR framework [ 14 ] , including the Stage 1 initialization, optimization settings, batch configuration, and checkpoint averaging. Stage 2 uses the same fixed pretrained NLLB model as in [ 22 ] without additional training or fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 实验配置. 培训和评估协议遵循我们先前的HP-VSR框架[14],包括第一阶段初始化、优化设置、批量配置和平均检查站。 第2阶段使用与[22]中相同的固定预训NLLB型号,无需额外训练或微调.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. VSR performance is evaluated using Word Error Rate (WER) [ 23 ] , which measures the proportion of word-level deletions, insertions, and substitutions relative to the reference text. Phoneme Error Rate (PER) is reported to assess recognition performance at the phoneme level.
blocks.zh: 评价计量。 VSR性能使用Word Error rate(WER)[23]来评价,该标准衡量与参考文本相比的词级删除,插入,替换的比例. 据报告,电话错误率(PER)用于评估电话级别的识别性能。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en: Comparison of Recent Representative Methods. Table 1 shows that our DR-FiLM (Deep + Res) configuration achieves the strongest LRS2 result among all video-only methods at comparable data scale (23.2% WER), outperforming GLip [ 19 ] , CM-aux [ 17 ] , and our own previous work, HP-VSR-ResFiLM [ 14 ] , while substantially recovering the degradation observed in the unweighted multi-pathway configuration (28.8% → \rightarrow 23.2% on LRS2, 39.0% → \rightarrow 34.4% on LRS3). This confirms that dynamic, input-dependent weighting is essential when combining multiple pose-conditioned FiLM pathways, consistent with our ablation findings in Table 2 . However, on LRS3, DR-FiLM (34.4%) does not surpass GLip (30.1%) or our prior single-location ResFiLM variant (30.3%), despite its clear advantage on LRS2. We attribute this discrepancy to differences in recording conditions between the two benchmarks: LRS2’s BBC broadcast footage and LRS3’s TED-talk footage differ in pose distribution, lighting, and speaker framing, which may affect how the dual-pathway modulation interacts with each domain. We view improving cross-dataset consistency of DR-FiLM as an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 最近代表的比较 方法。 办法。 表1显示,我们的DR-FiLM(深+Res)配置在可比较数据尺度(23.2%)、优于GLip[19]、CM-aux[17]和我们自己先前的工作HP-VSR-ResFiLM[14]中实现了最强的LRS2结果,同时大大恢复了在未加权的多路径配置中观察到的降解(28.8% =\ 右倾23.2%,LRS2、39.0% =\ 右倾34.4%)。 这证实,在结合多个姿势条件的FiLM路径时,动态的、依赖输入的加权至关重要,这与表2中我们的减值结果是一致的。 然而,在LRS3上,DR-FiLM(34.4%)并没有超过GLip(30.1%)或我们的先前的单位ResFiLM变体(30.3%),尽管它在LRS2上有明显的优势. 我们将此差异归因于两个基准之间记录条件的差异: LRS2的BBC广播镜头和LRS3的TED谈话镜头在姿势分布,照明和扬声器架设上各有不同,这可能会影响双向调制与每个域的相互作用. 我们认为,改进DR-FiLM的跨数据集一致性是今后工作的一个重要方向。

D denotes the Deep FiLM pathway applied at ResNet 18 Layers 3–4, while R denotes the ResFiLM pathway applied after the 2D CNN frontend. R → \rightarrow D shifts the weighting from ResFiLM toward Deep FiLM as the absolute yaw angle increases, whereas D → \rightarrow R applies the reverse weighting.

blocks.en: Analysis of DR-FiLM Configurations. Table 2 evaluates various dynamic-weighting configurations—including layer-wise weighting ( w 3 + w 4 + w res = 1 w_{3}+w_{4}+w_{\mathrm{res}}=1 ) and L4+Res weighting ( w 4 + w res = 1 w_{4}+w_{\mathrm{res}}=1 )—to analyze the impact of weighting granularity and modulation depth. Simply combining multiple FiLM pathways without adaptive weighting degrades performance significantly. For instance, the unweighted L3–L4 + ResFiLM baseline increases error rates on LRS2 (PER/WER rising from 16.20%/24.68% to 20.33%/28.84%) and LRS3 (from 20.96%/30.32% to 29.42%/38.98% compared to single HP-VSR-ResFiLM). This indicates that concurrently activating multiple pose-conditioned routes without coordination leads to feature interference. Dynamic weighting effectively mitigates this degradation, though performance varies by setup. While the layer-wise configuration yields mixed results (20.14%/29.01% on LRS2; 25.88%/35.54% on LRS3), the proposed DR-FiLM (Deep + Res) configuration achieves the best overall performance among dynamic variants (15.74%/23.24% on LRS2; 23.91%/34.43% on LRS3). Comparing this with the DR-FiLM (L4+Res) setup (16.79%/24.98% and 27.08%/37.58%) confirms that jointly weighting the deeper L3–L4 layers is superior to restricting adaptation to L4 alone. Finally, the Abs-FiLM variants test deterministic weighting based on absolute yaw. While both directional rules ( R → D R\rightarrow{}D : 18.79%/27.55% and 23.67%/33.90%; D → R D\rightarrow{}R : 19.76%/28.44% and 23.77%/33.82%) outperform the unweighted baseline, they remain inferior to learned DR-FiLM (Deep + Res). This demonstrates that input-dependent learned weighting is more robust than a rigid, heuristic pose-rule. Overall, DR-FiLM (Deep + Res) successfully recovers the degradation caused by unweighted multi-pathway modulation.

blocks.en: These findings show that the model assigns greater modulation strength to the deeper FiLM route under larger head-pose fluctuations, while decreasing the relative strength of the ResFiLM pathway. This behavior indicates that the suggested dynamic weighting method learns to alter modulation strength based on the input pose, rather than applying a set weighting to all samples. The increase in w deep w_{\mathrm{deep}} is more noticeable for highly posed samples, notably on LRS2. This suggests that deeper feature modulation may become more relevant as pose variation grows.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,模型在更大的头像波动下给更深的FiLM路径分配更大的调制强度,同时降低ResFiLM路径的相对强度. 这种行为表明,所建议的动态加权法学习根据输入姿势改变调制强度,而不是对所有样本应用一个设定的加权. 对高度浮现的样品,特别是LRS2的样品而言,w 深厚的 w mathrm{ diep}} 的增加更为明显。 这表明,随着变化的扩大,更深的特征调制可能变得更加重要。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Although our Dynamic FiLM framework mitigates unweighted multi-pathway degradation, it does not uniformly outperform the strongest HP-VSR-ResFiLM baseline across both benchmarks: while DR-FiLM (Deep + Res) surpasses the baseline on LRS2, a performance gap persists on LRS3. This indicates that dynamic weighting efficacy is sensitive to dataset characteristics like pose distribution and video quality.
blocks.zh: 尽管我们的动态FiLM框架减轻了未加权的多路径退化,但并没有在两个基准上统一超越最强的HP-VSR-ResFiLM基线:虽然DR-FiLM(深+Res)超过了LRS2基线,但LRS3上的性能差距仍然存在. 这表明动态权重的功效对诸如姿势分布和视频质量等数据集特性很敏感.

blocks.en: Future work will explore more expressive weighting mechanisms, extend utterance-level routing to frame-level temporal adaptation for within-utterance pose changes, and incorporate additional geometry (pitch and roll). Finally, broader cross-domain evaluations will help verify generalization across diverse recording conditions.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将探索更多表达式加权机制,将语音层面的路由扩展到帧层面的时间适应,以适应内切变化,并纳入更多的几何(pitch和roll). 最后,更广泛的跨领域评价将有助于核查不同记录条件的通用性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: This study proposes a Pose-Adaptive Dynamic FiLM framework with DR-FiLM to dynamically control multiple pose-conditioned FiLM pathways for VSR. Experiments on LRS2 and LRS3 show that unweighted multi-pathway modulation can substantially degrade recognition performance, while dynamic weighting effectively mitigates this degradation. The proposed DR-FiLM (Deep + Res) configuration achieves PER/WERs of 15.74%/23.24% on LRS2 and 23.91%/34.43% on LRS3, demonstrating the effectiveness of dynamically balancing the contributions of Deep FiLM and ResFiLM. The analysis reveals that the pathway weights vary with head-pose severity, implying that DR-FiLM can adapt feature modulation according to pose conditions rather than relying on a fixed configuration. These results highlight dynamic pose-conditioned weighting as an effective approach for improving the performance of phoneme-based VSR under varying head poses.
blocks.zh: 本研究提出了Pose-Adaptive动态FiLM框架,并配有DR-FiLM,以动态控制VSR的多个姿势条件的FiLM路径. 对LRS2和LRS3的实验表明,未加权的多路径调制可以大幅降解识别性能,而动态加权则能有效缓解这种降解. 拟议的DR-FiLM(深度+Res)配置在LRS2上实现了15.74%/WERs的PER/23.24%,在LRS3上实现了23.91%/34.43%的PER/WERs的PERs,证明了动态平衡深FiLM和ResFiLM贡献的效果. 分析显示,路径权重随头-头-面的严重程度而变化,这意味着DR-FiLM可以根据姿势条件而不是依赖固定配置来调整特征调制. 这些结果突出表明,动态的姿势条件加权是改善不同姿势下基于电话的VSR性能的有效办法。
